title: All souls’ day
html_source: All Souls' Day, in Christianity, is a day commemorating the faithful departed, in particular but not exclusively one’s relatives. In Western Christianity the annual celebration is now held on 2 November and is associated with All Saints' Day (1 November) and its vigil, Halloween (31 October)
